correctness.rationale: For fixed positive radii, folded angular differences are independent uniform. Intrinsic and chord squared distances are exact. The maximum occurs exactly on the nonzero binary-angle corners. At a corner with k antipodal coordinates the deficit is analytic in k linear defects and d-k squared coincident defects with positive coefficients, yielding a gamma-integral mass c_A epsilon^((d+k)/2)(1+O(epsilon)). Only k=1,2 contribute to the two leading orders; the rest is O(epsilon^((d+3)/2)). AM-GM proves rigidity, and Dirichlet conditional limit gives shape recovery. Direct independent 2-D quadrature, random-angle bound tests and sharp-constant tests replayed as 2436 checks; numerical tests are not substituted for analytic proof.
